notes.notes:
- Fixed unintended behavior after defeating ZBBA.
- Fixed an issue where the skills "Sticky Bomb" and "Molotov Cocktail" could be equipped at the same time.

notes.title: [Patch note: Ver. 1.33] Fixed issues caused by previous update.
notes.notes:
The changes in this build are as follows
Ver. 1.32 > Ver. 1.33
- Fixed an issue that items sold in the store become the same as at level 0 when the facility reaches level 7.(If your facility is already level 7, please leave hometown once and come back again.)
- Fixed issues on UI and gamepad control in some mini-games.

[h2][b]If the game still does not work properly after updating them, please try a clean install in the following way:[/b][/h2]
1. Right-click "Seed of the Dead: Sweet Home" in the Steam client and click Manage > Browse Local Files.
2. Uninstall the game.
3. Open Downloads from the Steam client settings and perform "CLEAR DOWNLOAD CACHE".
https://gyazo.com/45be7dc9d964ca681cf59d6ededf8111
4. Delete all remaining files in the folder you opened in step 1 (saved data is stored in a different location, and will not be deleted).
5. Reinstall the game.

The changes in this build are as follows:
Ver. 1.041 > Ver. 1.064
- Added notification if patch version is mismatched
- Fixed one of the issues that caused a crash on startup.
- Fixed some problems caused by optimization.
- Optimized textures to reduce memory consumption.
- Adjusted the UI to support 4:3 and 5:4 displays.
- Fixed an issue where weapons would disappear when exchanging weapons while looking through a scope.
- Fixed an unintended effect of some skills.
- Fixed an issue where the melee attack button would make a swinging sound during recovery actions.
- Fixed an issue where the kill counter of some enemies would not increase.

notes.title: Patch note: Ver1.041
notes.notes:
Overall game
- Fixed problems caused by older versions of save data
- Changed the default graphics settings
- Fixed an issue where the XY axis reversal check was reversed when come back to Hometown

Combat
- Fixed an issue where heroines would sometimes go down with her weapon still in her hand
- Fixed an issue where ZBBA would disappear after capturing a player due to the impact of an explosion
- Fixed an issue where KA47's reload motion and magazine removal were out of sync
- Fixed an issue where the player's shoots would shake specific part of the heroine
- The number of shaken times has been added to the player status
- The number of shaken times to unlock specific achievement has been reduced
- Fixed an issue where a quick look through the scope of a sniper rifle during combat would result in a blacked-out view the second time

Text
- Fixed some text, mainly in Spanish

Stages
- Optimized stages in general.
- Optimized each map to reduce lag caused by map loading during battle
Act2
- Fixed an issue where the shutter of the panic event could be interacted with from outside the warehouse
Act3
- Fixed an issue where if the heroine was on the tracks and jumped onto the platform, she would get stuck on the roof of the platform
- Fixed an issue where the map would not load when getting off the train after clearing a wave battle on the train
Act4
- Fixed an issue where the door to the library was misaligned
- Fixed an issue where going to the rooftop after the panic event ended would reset the panic event flag.
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to get an infinite amount of items on a closed school
ACT5
- Fixed an issue where the heroine would stick to the back of the wall in certain conditions during boss battle
- Fixed the problem of getting caught on a pole in the harbor
- Fixed the problem of riding up on objects in the boss stage
Act6
- Fixed a collision on the roof of the hotel and at the bottom of the stairs
Act7
- Fixed the problem of enemies not appearing during panic events
Act8
- Fixed the problem of enemies appearing after defeating the last boss
- Fixed an issue where the reverse bunny costume would obtained without unlocking the gimmick
- Added hints for additional costumes in the map

Home Town
- Fixed an issue where some of the conversations between Aya and Ichika were duplicated
- Fixed an issue where the menu could be called up when clicking on reminiscence mode
- Fixed an issue that prevented UI-related interactions from working when the end dialog was displayed - when fading out after a talk event
- Fixed an issue with the mesh on Kirara's battlesuit
- Fixed a bug in the mesh of Kirara's battlesuit 
- Fixed a problem with the desk in Aya's room
- Fixed a problem with the mesh of the battlesuit

Problems that may have been fixed (unconfirmed)
- Fixed a problem where facilities would not load properly
- Fixed an issue where textures in the hometown would become rough
- Fixed an issue where the heroine would stay in the player's position after she was down
